indicators.label: GDP Growth Rate
indicators.source: OECD KEI quarterly GDP growth; World Bank annual fallback
indicators.note: Quarterly where available; annual World Bank points are used only when OECD history is unavailable.

indicators.label: Interest Rate
indicators.source: OECD KEI monthly interest rates; World Bank annual fallback
indicators.note: Monthly short-term or policy-rate series where available; coverage differs by country.

indicators.label: Inflation Rate
indicators.source: OECD KEI monthly CPI inflation; World Bank annual fallback
indicators.note: Monthly year-over-year consumer price inflation where available.

indicators.label: Unemployment Rate
indicators.source: OECD KEI monthly unemployment rate; World Bank annual fallback
indicators.note: Monthly seasonally adjusted unemployment rate where available.

indicators.label: Government Debt to GDP
indicators.source: Central government debt, total (% of GDP)
indicators.note: World Bank annual series; many countries do not publish this as a monthly comparable G20 series.

indicators.label: Balance of Trade
indicators.source: OECD KEI monthly exports minus imports; World Bank annual fallback
indicators.note: Monthly goods and services balance in billions of US dollars where available.

indicators.label: Current Account to GDP
indicators.source: OECD KEI quarterly current account to GDP; World Bank annual fallback
indicators.note: Quarterly current account balance as a share of GDP where available.
